items.title: The Witcher 3 Devs Explain Using AI To Help With Geralt's Polish Voice In Songs Of The Past
items.excerpt: CD Projekt Red says the Polish voice of Geralt in the Songs of the Past expansion was tuned with AI, with the actor's consent, after he suffered a stroke between the original game and the new expansion.
items.note: Same story also at gamesradar (cd-projekt-red-worked-with-an-ai-company...) and destructoid; IGN/VGC also covered.

items.title: Creators Built Playable Worlds, VR Games & Digital Pets for Tripothon
items.excerpt: More than 2,000 teams from 78 countries took part in Tripo AI's first 3D-world hackathon (Tripothon S1), building playable worlds, VR games and digital pets with Tripo's generative 3D tools.

items.title: Microsoft Auto SR Exits Preview On ROG XBOX Ally X, New Performance Mode Raises FPS Limit To 120
items.excerpt: Microsoft's AI upscaler Auto SR leaves preview on the ROG Xbox Ally X, adding handheld support, 1080p upscaling and a 120 FPS Performance Mode.

items.title: Is nothing sacred: Shrek 2 Remastered pummeled on Steam over Epic Games account requirement and suspected "AI textures"
items.excerpt: Steam players are review-bombing Shrek 2 Remastered over a mandatory Epic account and textures they suspect were AI-upscaled or generated.

items.title: "Claude models are starting to refuse work on Pokemon fan projects," says vibe coder spending "up to $2,000" a month on Pokemon fan game
items.excerpt: The developer behind fan game Pokemon Arena 2D says Anthropic's Claude has begun refusing Pokemon fan-project work under its anti-clone policy, though the project will continue.
items.note: Follow-up to Anthropic game-clone block (published 11-02 via gamedeveloper); vibe-coding deprioritized.

items.title: Days before GTA 6, crime game for "thousands of players" blows up on Steam despite 50% positive reviews and gen AI use
items.excerpt: A multiplayer crime sim that discloses generative AI use is surging on Steam ahead of GTA 6 despite mixed reviews.

items.title: One Elder Scrolls fan is reviving and upgrading (with AI) a lost spin-off for the Nokia N-Gage and porting it to PC
items.excerpt: A fan is reviving The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey from the Nokia N-Gage, using AI to upgrade it and port it to PC.
items.note: AI role in body not verified in depth (Future plc body extraction failed) - enrichment should confirm.

items.title: This mod to get DLSS 5 running on AMD RX 9000-series GPUs promises better performance than others
items.excerpt: The AMDLSS5 mod gets Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering running on Radeon RX 9000 cards and claims 64% better performance than other mods.

items.title: 'Hogwarts Legacy' Gets a Magical NVIDIA DLSS 5 Upgrade on GeForce NOW
items.excerpt: Hogwarts Legacy adds DLSS 5 neural rendering on GeForce NOW, alongside 24 games coming to the service in November.

items.title: Following site-wide discussion on AI use, Nexus Mods add a "daily limit" to the spots in the new mods tab one person can hog
items.excerpt: After its AI-disclosure debate, Nexus Mods is trialling a daily cap on how many new-mods-tab slots one uploader can occupy with rapid-fire uploads.
items.note: Nexus Mods AI disclosure published 11-05; this is a follow-up platform policy action.

items.title: Nexon Wins Best Paper Award at ICTAI 2026
items.excerpt: Nexon researchers analysed about 19.37 million Steam reviews to find when players accept in-game AI, and built a pre-launch diagnostic for checking AI features before release.
items.note: invenglobal.com is the English arm of inven.co.kr (allowed).

items.title: 최석원 컴투스플랫폼 대표 "'하이브 액실'로 글로벌 공략⋯백엔드 연동 AI로 처리"
items.excerpt: 컴투스플랫폼은 게임 백엔드 플랫폼 '하이브 액실'을 AI가 이해할 수 있는 형태로 구현해 AI 에이전트가 백엔드 연동을 사람 개입 없이 처리하도록 했으며, 2027년 초 언리얼·고도·HTML5 지원을 확대한다.

items.title: 크래프톤, 3분기 누적 매출 3조6330억 원… 자체 AI 모델 성능도 공개
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 3분기 실적 발표에서 자체 LLM '라온' 모델의 성능을 공개하고 게임 밖 시장까지 수익화하겠다고 밝혔다.
items.note: Earnings-call item; qualifies only if Raon model is treated as concrete AI product.

items.title: 英語だけのゲームが遊びやすく。Unity製の作品を自動でリアルタイムに日本語化してくれるAI活用ツールが登場
items.excerpt: PLaMo 3 Translate를 쓰는 로컬 실행 도구로, 거의 모든 Unity 게임의 화면 텍스트를 실시간으로 일본어 번역해 표시한다. A free local tool uses PLaMo 3 Translate to translate almost any Unity game into Japanese in real time.
items.note: Uses PLaMo 3 Translate - PLaMo gamer tools were covered 11-10; AI localization cap reached. Likely same-story.

items.title: 심의에 AI 기술을? 한국게임법과정책학회 학술대회 연다
items.excerpt: 한국게임법과정책학회가 11월 20일 지스타 기간 부산 벡스코에서 AI 기술의 게임 등급분류 적용 등 게임 산업 법적 리스크를 다루는 학술대회를 연다.
items.note: Event preview - weak; keep query string intact.
